articles.title: UK signals end of 'light-touch' era with multi-agency raid on peer-to-peer crypto hubs
articles.snippet: Increased enforcement coincides with detailed regulatory guidance issued to crypto firms ahead of the full framework taking effect in late 2027.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin edges higher as Nasdaq climbs 1.7% in wake of Fed rate hike
articles.snippet: The SEC debuted its long-awaited "innovation exemption," providing a roadmap for blockchain-based venues to offer tokenized securities.

articles.title: CFTC expands regulatory relief for passive trading software providers
articles.snippet: The US regulator’s move could make it easier for crypto wallets and other apps to offer access to regulated derivatives and prediction markets without registering as introducing brokers.

articles.title: OG.com cleared by SEC to offer single-stock futures, says Crypto.com CEO
articles.snippet: Crypto.com’s CEO said its sister exchange was cleared to offer US access to single-stock perpetual futures, as the latest platform to bridge TradFi and digital assets.

articles.title: Crypto adoption blooming in Germany, while UK is falling ‘behind,’ says CoinShares researcher
articles.snippet: German crypto adoption is progressing through family offices and wealth managers, while the UK’s retail-facing cryptocurrency market remains “nascent,” according to the researcher.
